recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast male portrait in a black leather jacket and white shirt, set against a vibrant orange-to-yellow gradient background featuring subtle, large-scale abstract brushstroke textures. The composition uses a clean, geometric sans-serif typeface with extreme thinness and vertical line extensions.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark clothing anchors the bottom right against the bright background.
Vertical typographic stems align with the subject's hands and tie.
Warm background tones contrast with the cool, desaturated skin tones of the subject.
coreInvariants: Vibrant orange-yellow radial or linear gradient.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped from the waist up, leaning slightly forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands adjusting a tie serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the hands down to the tie, then moves left to the large-scale typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side to accommodate large, airy text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (Leather jacket and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background vs. low saturation, high contrast subject.

letterConstructionRules: Extended vertical ascenders that reach the top of the frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders of 'h', 'l', and 'b' are elongated into thin vertical lines that span the height of the layout.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and color contrast within the same geometric family.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Perfect geometric circles and thin weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a man in a black leather jacket and white shirt against a vibrant orange and yellow gradient background with faint, large abstract brushstrokes. Ensure the left side has ample negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, black, ultra-thin geometric sans-serif text in lowercase. Extend the vertical stems of the 'h', 'l', and 'b' to the top edge of the frame. Add a third line of smaller white text below.

verificationChecks: Vertical stems extend to the top edge.
Background is a vibrant orange gradient.
Subject is high-contrast black and white/desaturated.

postGenerationChecks: Are the counters of the letters perfectly circular?
Is the contrast between the black jacket and orange background sharp?
Do the vertical lines feel integrated into the layout?
Is the lighting on the subject's face dramatic and directional?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, high-contrast portrait with a high-saturation geometric background, then overlay hairline geometric sans-serif type with exaggerated vertical ascenders.
